column1: # A guest's files (xpute-guest ipc/file, the system calls in ARCHITECTURE.md): what a guest
# owes the host's answers to its opens. The host's own end — roots, paths, reads, writes — is
# sys/file.tsv's; this is the guest's, held across every guest. A descriptor is a handle, so the
# trace binds them by name and holds them to relations, as handle.tsv does.
# The host answers an open with SYS_OPENED, xpute's own command, on a later turn however much later;
# here a step sends it, so the answer can be made to arrive after the descriptor it names has closed.
# An open is a descriptor of its own.
# The first is closed before its answer came, and the next open takes its slot.
# The late answer to the closed one reaches no one — not its owner, 5, and not the slot's new one; the
# new one's answer reaches its owner, 6, alone; and the closed descriptor is not one to close again.
